title: Principles of Macroeconomics
description: The principles of macroeconomic analysis with special reference to fluctuations in income and prices, monetary and fiscal policies for economic stabilization.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECON 104, ECON 202.
ECON 104 cannot be taken concurrently with ECON 100.
recommendations: One of MATH 120, Principles of Mathematics 12, Pre-Calculus 12 recommended prior to ECON 104.
